title: AD: Kerberoasting — service account with hardcoded password (no gMSA)
description: Service account created with hardcoded password instead of gMSA. Allows offline Kerberoasting of SPN ticket.

title: AD: NTLM Relay — LDAP/SMB signing disabled
description: LDAP/SMB signing explicitly disabled (registry key set to 0). Enables NTLM relay attacks to ADCS or LDAP (RBCD/shadow creds).

title: AD: LAPS — overly permissive read ACL
description: LAPS local admin password readable by overly broad group. Enables lateral movement across domain.

title: AD: ADCS — certificate template without EPA
description: ADCS certificate template created/added — verify Extended Protection for Authentication (EPA) is enforced. Without EPA: NTLM relay to ADCS = domain admin.
